BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, euthýtēs is the word for righteousness. In Hebrews 1:8, the text says "a sceptre of righteousness [is] the sceptre of thy kingdom."
TheologicalSignificance: I read euthýtēs plainly — it means righteousness, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
